final_answer: The document discusses a research paper titled "An Examination of the Impact of Climate Change on Global Agriculture" by Smith et al. (2020). The research paper investigates the effects of climate change on crop yields, agricultural practices, and food security across various regions worldwide. It also provides recommendations for sustainable agricultural practices to mitigate the negative impacts of climate change on agriculture. [Source: search_knowledge_base]
